latest_canonical_articles.title: After 20 Years, Have HDAC Inhibitors Finally Found Their Role? Why ABT-301 Could Become a Next-Generation Combination Backbone
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Chidamide has brought HDAC inhibition back into solid-tumor development. ABT-301 must now show that a wider therapeutic window, triplet combinability, and human immune-mechanism data can support a next-generation combination backbone.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 20年後，HDAC抑制劑終於找到真正的位置？ABT-301能否成為下一代聯合治療骨幹
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Chidamide以pMMR大腸癌44% ORR與黑色素瘤第三期PFS達標，重新降低HDAC抑制劑的類別風險；安邦ABT-301接下來必須用治療窗口、三聯可組合性與人體免疫機轉，證明資產差異。

latest_canonical_articles.title: 禮來領頭，大藥廠半年豪砸 1,300 億美元搶時間！
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 2026 年上半年生技製藥併購總額約 1,300 億美元，買家偏向臨床後期與接近上市的資產。這一輪不是全面牛市，而是大藥廠在專利懸崖前，用交易結構與現金購買可計算的開發時間。

latest_canonical_articles.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Biopharma M&A reached approximately $130 billion in the first half of 2026 as buyers favored late-stage and near-launch assets. This is not a broad biotech bull market; it is Big Pharma using cash and contingent deal structures to buy measurable development time before the patent cliff.

latest_canonical_articles.title: J&J's Oral Psoriasis Drug Logged 18,000 Prescriptions in Its First Full Quarter. Is It Coming for Injectables?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: ICOTYDE logged more than 18,000 prescriptions in its first full quarter. The oral IL-23R peptide has earned entry into the high-efficacy psoriasis market, but durable value still depends on paid fills, persistence, payer quality, safety, and additional indications.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 嬌生口服藥首季 1.8 萬張處方，針劑飯碗要被搶了？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: ICOTYDE 上市後第一個完整季度累積逾 18,000 張處方。口服 IL-23R 胜肽已取得進入高療效市場的資格，真正的商業答案仍取決於續方、支付品質、長期留存與多適應症。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Why These Four Biotechs Can Afford Not to Sell
latest_canonical_articles.summary: argenx, Insmed, Incyte, and Revolution Medicines show why biotech independence depends on product evidence, cash generation, a second growth curve, global execution, and financing without surrendering control.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 不賣給大藥廠，4 家生技公司憑什麼自己做大？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: argenx、Insmed、Incyte 與 Revolution Medicines 選擇保留獨立經營權。真正的不賣資格，來自產品證據、現金引擎、第二曲線、全球執行與不交出控制權也能取得資金的能力。

latest_canonical_articles.title: 22 億美元，買下一個自體免疫藥王？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: argenx 擬以 22 億美元現金收購 Forte，把早期抗 CD122 抗體 FB102 納入管線。真正的考題不是一組一期 p 值，而是 VYVGART 的單品成功能否被複製成可重複的公司能力。

latest_canonical_articles.title: $2.2 Billion for the Next Autoimmune Blockbuster?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: argenx plans to pay $2.2 billion in cash for Forte and its early anti-CD122 antibody FB102. The real test is not one Phase 1b p-value, but whether VYVGART's product success reflects a development engine the company can repeat.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Investors, Take Note: Hair Loss Could Be Biotech's Next Weight-Loss-Drug-Sized Blockbuster
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Lilly has placed a $40 million bet on next-generation hair-loss drugs. With roughly 80 million U.S. patients still constrained by two legacy therapies, AH-001's Phase 2 data could become the next global asset-revaluation trigger.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 投資人請注意，下一個減肥藥級別賽道來了！
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 禮來用 4,000 萬美元卡位掉髮新藥；當美國約 8,000 萬名患者仍受限於兩款老藥，安宏 AH-001 的二期數據可能成為下一次全球資產重估關鍵。

latest_canonical_articles.title: More Than $1 Billion in One Quarter: Why Did Alnylam Plunge 28%?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Amvuttra surpassed $1 billion in quarterly sales, yet Alnylam cut its TTR guidance and lost 28% in one day. The reset was not about RNAi technology failing; it was about pent-up demand normalizing, revenue concentration and the timing gap before a second commercial pillar arrives.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 一季賣破 10 億，Alnylam 為何崩 28%？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Amvuttra 單季銷售突破 10 億美元，Alnylam 卻下修 TTR 指引並重挫 28%。真正被重估的不是 RNAi 技術，而是積壓需求退潮、收入集中與下一個商業支柱的時間差。

latest_canonical_articles.title: A $400 Billion Pharma Merger? AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb Are Reportedly Talking
latest_canonical_articles.summary: AstraZeneca and BMS reportedly explored a combination with a combined market value approaching $400 billion. There is no announced transaction. The real questions are AstraZeneca's 2030 growth target, BMS's Eliquis and Opdivo exclusivity timeline, oncology-pipeline overlap, antitrust and whether integration can actually buy time.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 超級大藥廠 4,000 億美元合併？阿斯特捷利康＋BMS！
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Financial Times 報導 AstraZeneca 與 BMS 曾探討結合，合計市值接近 4,000 億美元。這不是已簽交易；真正的產業問題是 2030 成長、Eliquis／Opdivo 獨占期、腫瘤管線重疊、反壟斷與整合能否買到時間。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Tau Earned a Retest: Why Biogen Is Taking Diranersen Into Phase 3 After CELIA Missed Its Primary Endpoint
latest_canonical_articles.summary: CELIA missed its prespecified dose-response primary endpoint, yet the lowest dose produced a 0.54-point CDR-SB difference, or 26% slowing, while CSF total tau and tau PET moved in the expected direction. That is enough to justify Phase 3 planning, but not enough to declare tau a validated second disease-modifying pathway.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Tau 拿到補考資格：Diranersen 主終點失敗，為什麼 Biogen 仍要進三期？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: CELIA 未達預設劑量反應主要終點，最低劑量卻在 CDR-SB 看到 26% 惡化減緩，CSF total tau 與 Tau PET 也同向下降。這些訊號足以讓 Biogen 與 Ionis 規劃三期，還不足以宣布 Tau 已成為第二條獲確認的疾病修飾路線。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Bempikibart in Alopecia Areata: A 33-Patient Signal Is Not Yet a Win Over JAK Inhibitors
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Q32 Bio nearly doubled after a 33-patient, single-arm Phase 2a readout. The investable questions are whether efficacy survives randomization, whether responses persist after treatment stops, and whether a larger safety database can support a differentiated place beside JAK inhibitors.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 鬼剃頭新藥，先別封神
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 33 人、單臂、開放標籤的 Phase 2a 資料讓 Q32 Bio 股價近乎翻倍；真正的問題是療效能否重現、停藥後能否維持，以及安全性是否足以改變 JAK 抑制劑的臨床位置。

latest_canonical_articles.summary: Xtandi still dominates Astellas oncology sales. The real test is whether Padcev, Vyloy and the next CLDN18.2 assets can become a repeatable post-LOE platform.
